# MaskPreset

`Flare.Components.MaskPreset`

Ready-made mask patterns for FlareMaskedField. When set (and no explicit Mask is given), the corresponding pattern is used. Pattern tokens: # digit, A letter, * alphanumeric.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No preset - use the explicit Mask. |
| `Phone` | `1` | US phone: (###) ###-####. |
| `Date` | `2` | Date: ##/##/####. |
| `Time` | `3` | Time: ##:##. |
| `IpAddress` | `4` | IPv4 address: ###.###.###.###. |
| `CreditCard` | `5` | Credit card: #### #### #### ####. |
| `Ssn` | `6` | US SSN: ###-##-####. |

## Used by components

- `FlareMaskedField`
